analysis.summary: Observed entry guard on a container count, selection of a sorted/unsorted element slice, per-record key lookup in two hash-backed maps, float ratio comparison against constant 0.05, emission into param_4/param_5-backed collections, and drop/removal loop with per-variant decrement. Unresolved callee meanings and NaN handling.
